'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Tom Schwarz DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
